g.text: Option Desk - Capability selection and access checks
An explicit provider is strict by default.
Failure does not silently select a different provider.
A key is not proof of redistribution rights.
Alpha Vantage supplies history and quotes, not option chains.
The import route does not resolve a live provider.
Its source and permission checks still apply.
.py, providers/base.py, providers/yahoo.py and cli/chain.py. No provider quota or availability claim.
